text: And he said{H559} unto me, Son{H1121} of man,{H120} stand{H5975} upon thy feet,{H7272} and I will speak{H1696} with thee.
And the Spirit{H7307} entered{H935} into me when he spake{H1696} unto me, and set{H5975} me upon my feet;{H7272} and I heard{H8085} him that spake{H1696} unto me.

And he said{H559} unto me, Son{H1121} of man,{H120} I send{H7971} thee to the children{H1121} of Israel,{H3478} to nations{H1471} that are rebellious,{H4775} which have rebelled{H4775} against me: they and their fathers{H1} have transgressed{H6586} against me even unto this very{H6106} day.{H3117}
And the children{H1121} are impudent{H7186} and stiffhearted:{H2389} I do send{H7971} thee unto them; and thou shalt say{H559} unto them, Thus saith{H559} the Lord{H136} Jehovah.{H3069}

And they, whether they will hear,{H8085} or whether they will forbear,{H2308} (for they are a rebellious{H4805} house,){H1004} yet shall know{H3045} that there hath been a prophet{H5030} among{H8432} them.

And thou, son{H1121} of man,{H120} be not afraid{H3372} of them, neither be afraid{H3372} of their words,{H1697} though briers{H5621} and thorns{H5544} are with thee, and thou dost dwell{H3427} among scorpions:{H6137} be not afraid{H3372} of their words,{H1697} nor be dismayed{H2865} at their looks,{H6440} though they are a rebellious{H4805} house.{H1004}
And thou shalt speak{H1696} my words{H1697} unto them, whether they will hear,{H8085} or whether they will forbear;{H2308} for they are most rebellious.{H4805}

But thou, son{H1121} of man,{H120} hear{H8085} what I say{H1696} unto thee; be not{H1961} thou rebellious{H4805} like that rebellious{H4805} house:{H1004} open{H6475} thy mouth,{H6310} and eat{H398} that which I give{H5414} thee.
And when I looked,{H7200} behold, a hand{H3027} was put{H7971} forth unto me; and, lo, a roll{H4039} of a book{H5612} was therein;
And he spread{H6566} it before{H6440} me: and it was written{H3789} within{H6440} and without;{H268} and there were written{H3789} therein lamentations,{H7015} and mourning,{H1899} and woe.{H1958}
